headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The day's top MLB news saw several teams emerge victorious, while others struggled to keep pace. The Washington Nationals took down the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense. The Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with Eli White leading the Athletics' offense. The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory behind Sean Manaea's strong performance. The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6, with Kyle Schwarber leading the Phillies' offense.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Tyler Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to lumbar pain. Nathan Eovaldi has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to right posterior elbow inflammation. Shaun Anderson has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Los Angeles Angels due to right shoulder inflammation. Devin Williams has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the New York Mets due to right shoulder strain. Caleb Kilian has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Philadelphia Phillies due to left oblique strain.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place around the league. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with 3 hits in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6 in a closely contested game. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Tyler Freeman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right fielder Tyler Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain, effective retroactive to August 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Berry Joins Royals in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins on August 5, 2026. Berry is now a member of the Kansas City Royals.
